_note: Source of truth for all game audio. scripts/gen_game_audio.py renders each entry to <id>.mp3 next to this file (skips existing). Game shows `text` minus [audio tags] as subtitles.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Helsinki. Friday morning. One hotel. One thousand litres of lactose-free milk. And one buyer who still does it... the old way.

lines.speaker: chef
lines.text: [panicked] Hi, it's Marja from the kitchen! Listen, the dairy conference checks in Monday, three hundred guests, forty of them lactose intolerant. I need one thousand litres of lactose-free milk by Monday. Budget is two and a half thousand euros. Go, go, go!

lines.speaker: chef
lines.text: [stressed] Any luck? Pastry chef just asked me if oat milk counts. [sighs] It does NOT count. Please hurry!

lines.speaker: chef
lines.text: [shouting] It's almost lunch! Are you driving around Helsinki looking for MILK? In 2026? [laughs nervously] Okay. Okay. I'm fine.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.text: Lindqvist here. Finance tells me you got a parking ticket. Reminder: two thousand five hundred euros. Not a cent more. Also, where is the audit trail for all this? [pause] There isn't one, is there.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.text: It's Lindqvist. The procurement report for the board is due at five. Please tell me you have an order confirmation number. [long pause] I'll take that as a no.

lines.speaker: north
lines.text: [grumpy] Moi. Lactose-free? Yeah, we have some.

lines.speaker: north
lines.text: [deadpan] One thousand litres? Ei oo. We have one hundred twenty. Take it or leave it. Mostly leave it.

lines.speaker: mega
lines.text: [excited] Welcome to MegaDairy, my friend! Premium lactose-free, five thousand litres, ready to roll!

lines.speaker: mega
lines.text: [cheerfully] That'll be three thousand four hundred euros! [laughs] What do you mean, budget? Budgets are a state of mind!

lines.speaker: corner
lines.text: [whispers] Psst. Milk. Cheap milk. Ninety-nine cents.

lines.speaker: corner
lines.text: [shrugs] Lactose-free, regular... it's all milk, right? Your guests won't notice. [pause] Probably.

lines.speaker: harbour
lines.text: [bored] Harbour Wholesale. Yeah, we've got Valio Eila. Ten litre boxes. Lactose free. Good price.

lines.speaker: harbour
lines.text: [yawns] But the order cut-off was Thursday at three. It's Friday. Come back next week.

lines.speaker: aimo
lines.text: New request from Hotel Kalevala. One thousand litres, lactose free, by Monday. On it.

lines.speaker: aimo
lines.text: [calm] Order placed. Fifty cases of Valio Eila, fifteen hundred sixty-five euros fifty. Four jurors approved. Audit chain verified. [pause] Your buyer is still at a red light.

lines.speaker: tier0
lines.text: Code gates: within budget, not sales blocked. Approve.

lines.speaker: spec
lines.text: Spec juror: declares free from lactose. Approve.

lines.speaker: delivery
lines.text: Delivery juror: available Monday the sixteenth. Stock is estimated, noted. Approve.

lines.speaker: cost
lines.text: Cost juror: one fifty-seven per litre, under the auto-approve limit. Approve.

lines.speaker: dj
lines.text: [energetic] Goooood morning Helsinki, you're listening to Radio Maito, the only station that's ninety-nine percent dairy! Roads are icy, trams are moody, let's go!

lines.speaker: ad
lines.text: Still driving to wholesalers? Still calling around for prices? It's twenty twenty-six. [pause] There's an agent for that. Aimo. Order like it's the future.

lines.speaker: dj
lines.text: Traffic update: a tram is blocking the central junction, again, and snow is coming in. Perfect day to drive around buying milk by hand! [laughs]

lines.speaker: trucker
lines.text: [laughs] Coming through! Fifty cases for Hotel Kalevala. Somebody ordered it ages ago!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Same order. One of you is still in traffic.

lines.speaker: aimo
lines.text: Want to try? Tell me what your kitchen needs, and I'll order it live.
